statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess for ischemic changes related to the patient's documented coronary artery disease
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered
